tutorial.combo_hint: Chain hits to raise your combo rank!

intro.scene_01: Deep within the Amazon rainforest, an ancient force awakens...
intro.scene_02: Ybytu, guardian of the winds, senses a disturbance in nature's balance.
intro.scene_03: Corrupted creatures begin to emerge, threatening the forest's harmony.
intro.scene_04: It is time to act. The Wrath of the Forest shall be unleashed.

final.scene_01: With the last enemy defeated, the forest begins to recover.
final.scene_02: Ybytu feels nature's energy flowing in balance once more.
final.scene_03: Peace returns, but the guardian knows he must remain vigilant.
final.scene_04: For as long as the forest is threatened, Ybytu's Wrath stands ready.

stage_01_intro.scene_01: Ybytu arrives at the forest entrance and finds traces of destruction.
stage_01_intro.scene_02: The invaders are not far. It's time to defend this place.

stage_01_outro.scene_01: The entrance is secure, but danger continues deeper into the forest.
stage_01_outro.scene_02: Ybytu presses further into the woods.

stage_02_intro.scene_01: In the heart of the forest, the darkness grows thicker.
stage_02_intro.scene_02: The creatures here are stronger. Ybytu must proceed with caution.

stage_02_outro.scene_01: The center is purified, but the source of corruption still exists.

stage_03_intro.scene_01: The sacred spring... is completely corrupted.
stage_03_intro.scene_02: A malevolent presence guards this place. The final confrontation approaches.

stage_03_outro.scene_01: The creature falls, and the spring begins to glow once more.
stage_03_outro.scene_02: The forest is saved... for now.

stage_01.name: Forest Entrance
stage_01.description: The first invaders appear at the forest's edge.

stage_02.name: Heart of the Woods
stage_02.description: Corruption spreads through the center of the forest.

stage_03.name: Corrupted Spring
stage_03.description: The source of corruption is revealed at the sacred spring.

npc_elder.name: Forest Elder
npc_elder.greeting: Ybytu, I'm glad you came. The forest needs you.
npc_elder.hint_01: Watch out for enemies that attack in groups. Use your combos!
npc_elder.hint_02: The higher your combo, the stronger your hits become.
npc_elder.hint_03: But be careful, with great power comes great vulnerability.
npc_elder.farewell: Go with the forest's blessing, guardian.

npc_spirit.name: Forest Spirit
npc_spirit.hint_01: The corrupted creatures fear the light of the spring.
npc_spirit.farewell: May the winds guide your path.

boss_01.name: Forest Corruptor
boss_01.intro: So you're the famous guardian? Pathetic.
boss_01.death: Impossible... defeated by a forest creature...

boss_02.name: Shadow of the Spring
boss_02.intro: This spring is mine now. You're too late.

health_small.name: Healing Fruit
health_small.description: Restores a small amount of health.

health_large.name: Life Fruit
health_large.description: Restores a large amount of health.
